summary.en: If your name changes through marriage and you are a mid- to long-term resident with a residence card, report the change of your residence card details within 14 days of the change (to be checked). Submit your passport showing the new name and a marriage certificate (a family register transcript if you married a Japanese national). If your passport has not been corrected or reissued first, the card may not be issued the same day.

text.en: For a name change through marriage, submit a passport showing the new name and a marriage certificate (a family register transcript if you married a Japanese national).

excluded.en: Shown when your own name changes through marriage and you are a foreign national with a residence card. Not shown to Japanese nationals. If only your partner's name changes, it is your partner's procedure. Special Permanent Resident Certificate holders report elsewhere (to be checked).
